mapper.sql: r.*, e.name as employee_name, e.employee_no, CASE WHEN d.unit_type = 2 THEN d.unit_name WHEN p1.unit_type = 2 THEN p1.unit_name WHEN p2.unit_type = 2 THEN p2.unit_name WHEN p3.unit_type = 2 THEN p3.unit_name ELSE NULL END as company_name, d.unit_name as dept_name, s.shift_name, COALESCE(app.overtime_duration, 0) as overtime_duration, COALESCE(app.business_duration, 0) as business_duration, COALESCE(app.annual_leave_duration, 0) as annual_leave_duration, COALESCE(app.personal_leave_duration, 0) as personal_leave_duration, COALESCE(app.sick_leave_duration, 0) as sick_leave_duration, COALESCE(app.marriage_leave_duration, 0) as marriage_leave_duration, COALESCE(app.maternity_leave_duration, 0) as maternity_leave_duration, COALESCE(app.paternity_leave_duration, 0) as paternity_leave_duration, COALESCE(app.bereavement_leave_duration, 0) as bereavement_leave_duration

FROM att_daily_record r LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN org_unit d ON e.dept_id = d.id LEFT JOIN org_unit p1 ON d.parent_id = p1.id LEFT JOIN org_unit p2 ON p1.parent_id = p2.id LEFT JOIN org_unit p3 ON p2.parent_id = p3.id LEFT JOIN att_shift s ON r.shift_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.employee_id, DATE(a.start_time) as app_start, DATE(a.end_time) as app_end, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'overtime' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as overtime_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'business' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as business_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'leave' AND a.title = '1' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as annual_leave_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'leave' AND a.title = '2' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as personal_leave_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'leave' AND a.title = '3' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as sick_leave_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'leave' AND a.title = '4' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as marriage_leave_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'leave' AND a.title = '5' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as maternity_leave_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'leave' AND a.title = '6' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as paternity_leave_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN a.app_type = 'leave' AND a.title = '7' THEN a.duration ELSE 0 END) as bereavement_leave_duration FROM hr_application a WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.app_type IN ('overtime', 'business', 'leave') GROUP BY a.employee_id, DATE(a.start_time), DATE(a.end_time) ) app ON app.employee_id = r.employee_id AND app.app_start <= r.att_date AND app.app_end >= r.att_date
